sources.note: Nothing on stress. Establishes identity: citing Elders (2006: 44-45), Tessmann (1928: 322, 340) placed the Dek between the Mbaye and Ouham rivers in CAR, Greenberg (1963: 9) listed 'Dek' with Mbum without references, Monino (1995: 709) concluded the Dek are identical with the Suma NW of Bossangoa; quotes Elders: 'The name Dek should therefore be omitted from the inventory of Kebi-Benoue [= Mbum] languages.'
